Phase 1 (Mark I): prove the principle with instrumented prototypes and publish everything. Phase 2 (Mark II): refine to practical reliability with independent safety review. Phase 3 (Mark III): mature to routine operation with full lifecycle support.

Each phase gates on the previous: no phase begins until the prior phase meets its safety and performance criteria in open review.

Speculative concept technology. Signature-generated for study, imagination, and design exploration. Not established real-world fact; not instructions for building weapons or hazardous devices. Nothing herein is medical, legal, or engineering advice.

models.mark1: Mark I proves the link with slow, narrow, short-range transmission.
models.mark2: Mark II is network-grade in fiction: fast, broadband, and interplanetary.
models.mark3: Mark III is the mature network: effectively instant, immense bandwidth, interstellar reach.
